{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display the first few rows
display(trial_df.head())

# Display data types and missing values
print("\nData Types:")
print(trial_df.dtypes)

print("\nMissing Values:")
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print("\nDuplicate rows:", trial_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check the distribution of treatment and control groups
print("\nTreatment group distribution:")
print(trial_df['treatment'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of response
print("\nResponse distribution:")
print(trial_df['response'].value_counts())"}
